Market today: The mood is mixed. Positive news for chip manufacturing in the US is a tailwind for your concentrated tech/chip book, but the 10-year Treasury yield hovering above 5% is a significant headwind, especially with your margin exposure. The upcoming Fed decision is the real driver.

Your holdings: SOXL (-59.8%) and SPAL (-37.89%) are in dire straits due to leverage and massive losses; their default stops need immediate review. SMH (-14.81%) and QQQI (-4.47%) are also very close to their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield and the Fed's decision. Also, monitor any follow-through on the US chip manufacturing news.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged and underwater positions, especially with macro headwinds.
plays: SOXL: Review your stop on this leveraged position immediately. A 59.8% loss on margin is unsustainable; consider cutting losses if it doesn't rebound fast.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, this leveraged ETF is down 37.89%. Re-evaluate your stop and risk exposure here.
QCOM: Consider accumulating QCOM (entry 187.31-187.13, stop 186.42) given positive chip news and its strong scanner setup.
